This page is a static test page with one tiny inline script that only writes the year in the footer. All of the real text is in the HTML that the server sends, so the audit kit must read it as a normal server-rendered page and must never call it an empty shell until JavaScript runs.

Our bread

We bake sourdough, rye and white loaves every morning before seven. Each loaf uses flour from a local mill, water, salt and time. We do not add any sugar or fat to the plain loaves.
